name: Neuronic Cloud Backend

dispatch_notes.coder-backend: Lambda handlers, Prisma schemas, service business logic
dispatch_notes.coder-infra: CDK stacks, API Gateway config, IAM roles, environment setup
dispatch_notes.coder: General TypeScript logic, Zod schemas, shared utilities
dispatch_notes.api-designer: REST API endpoints, request/response schemas, Cognito auth flows
dispatch_notes.security-auditor: Cognito auth, IAM policies, Secrets Manager usage, IoT certificates
dispatch_notes.tester: Jest tests, requires local PostgreSQL via docker-compose
dispatch_notes.ci-cd: GitHub Actions workflows, multi-service build ordering

guidance.stack_summary: TypeScript 5 / AWS CDK 2.230 / Prisma 5 / PostgreSQL 16 / Lambda / API Gateway + Cognito / Zod / Jest
structure: Services/User/ — User account, device, and certificate management
Services/Admin/ — Dashboard, patient search (depends on Program, Surveys, User)
docs/ — Development guides and infrastructure diagrams
test/ — Jest configuration and test files
conventions: Strict TypeScript with strict null checks
Only TODO and DECISION tags allowed, no regular comments
Repository pattern via Prisma clients per service
Winston logging with try-catch error handling
ci_cd: PR check: lint → format → parallel builds (Program, Surveys, Firmware, User) → Admin (sequential) → parallel tests → drift detection
Dev deploy: auto on merge to main
Stage/Prod deploy: triggered by release/v* branches
Custom semantic versioning from PR titles (major/minor/patch)
testing: Per-service Prisma client generation before tests
build_order: Program, Surveys, Firmware, User can build in parallel
Admin must build after Program, Surveys, User (depends on their Prisma clients)

custom_rules: Service dependency order: Admin depends on Program + Surveys + User Prisma clients
Lambda handlers require copy:binaries step for Prisma .node files
Environment selection via CDK context: --context env=dev|staging|prod
